head_commit.message:
Identify failed SQLite databases in `codex doctor` output (#47330)

## Why

The generic state integrity failure message does not identify which database needs attention.

## What changed

- Include the paths of all databases that fail integrity checks in a structured issue, shown in text summaries and JSON output, with the existing recovery guidance.
- Redact sensitive details using `: ` as the field-label separator so Windows drive letters are not mistaken for labels and unlabeled sensitive paths are fully redacted.

## Testing

Add coverage for single and multiple failed databases, summary and detailed text output, JSON output, preservation of damaged database contents, and sensitive path redaction on Unix and Windows.

GitOrigin-RevId: ac5fec9473d22b6b137a9fc8a751aba8605d940f

Document the convention in `codex-rs/tui/styles.md`, including normal punctuation for descriptions with multiple sentences and preservation of externally supplied descriptions.

head_commit.message:
Preserve image generation request IDs on failure (#47327)

## Why

Failed image requests discarded the `x-codex-imagegen-request-id` header, leaving failure analytics without the request ID.

## What changed

Carry the request ID through `ImageRequestError` and backend errors for image generation and editing. Preserve it on failed image generation items for HTTP errors, response decoding errors, and responses with no image data.

## Testing

Extend the app-server failure test to verify that a request ID returned with an HTTP 500 response reaches `codex_image_generation_event` analytics.

GitOrigin-RevId: 57cddacc0221e5b58877ac375d5eca0afb99d853

head_commit.message:
Keep report reason tags within Sentry limits (#47325)

## Why

Sentry tags cannot contain newlines or exceed 200 characters, but report comments can contain both.

## What changed

Limit the `reason` tag to the first 200 Unicode characters and replace each carriage return or newline with a space. Preserve the full, unchanged comment in the exception body.

head_commit.message:
Persist resume metadata in compaction checkpoints (#47323)

## Why

Compaction companion records do not represent all resume state, including the last started turn and previous turn settings. The selected multi-agent runtime also needs a persisted value when no companion turn context is present.

## What changed

- Add optional `resume_metadata` to `CompactedItem`, recording the multi-agent version, last started turn ID, and previous turn settings. Preserve the distinction between absent metadata and explicitly empty values while retaining compatibility with older records.
- Capture this metadata under the settings persistence lock alongside the compaction checkpoint.
- Rewrite inherited metadata to use the child agent's runtime, and clear previous turn settings when the child must rebuild context.
- Clear pending continuation state before delivering acceptance of standalone settings updates, while holding the persistence lock.

## Testing

Add coverage for metadata round trips with empty values, legacy reader compatibility, checkpoint companion records, inherited fork metadata, and continuation invalidation while settings event delivery is blocked.

head_commit.message:
Persist resume metadata in compaction checkpoints (#47323)

## Why

Compaction companion records do not represent all resume state, including the last started turn and previous turn settings. The selected multi-agent runtime also needs a persisted value when no companion turn context is present.

## What changed

- Add optional `resume_metadata` to `CompactedItem`, recording the multi-agent version, last started turn ID, and previous turn settings. Preserve the distinction between absent metadata and explicitly empty values while retaining compatibility with older records.
- Capture this metadata under the settings persistence lock alongside the compaction checkpoint.
- Rewrite inherited metadata to use the child agent's runtime, and clear previous turn settings when the child must rebuild context.
- Clear pending continuation state before delivering acceptance of standalone settings updates, while holding the persistence lock.

## Testing

Add coverage for metadata round trips with empty values, legacy reader compatibility, checkpoint companion records, inherited fork metadata, and continuation invalidation while settings event delivery is blocked.

Render TUI Markdown lists with Unicode bullets and checkboxes (#47322)

Render unordered bullets as `•` and task markers as `☐` or `☑`, preserving ordered numbering and continuation indentation in streaming and completed Markdown. Add `tui.rendering.lists`, enabled by default; setting it to `false` retains hyphen bullets and textual task markers.

Add snapshot coverage for nested, ordered, quoted, and wrapped task lists, plus code and escaped markers. Add character-by-character streaming tests that compare incremental and emitted output with full rendering, with list rendering enabled and disabled.

Several TUI views hard-code 24-hour timestamps even when the detected system preference is 12-hour time.

Use the existing `ClockFormat` preference for rate-limit and spend-control reset times, usage notices, backend banners, reset-credit expiration times, analytics timestamps, and expanded session details in the resume picker. ## Testing

Add coverage for midnight, noon, and next-day reset labels in both clock formats, plus 12-hour analytics rendering with UTC labels. Update snapshots for status, banners, usage notices, reset-credit details, and expanded sessions, including narrow-width layouts. Pin test fixtures to explicit clock formats for deterministic output.
